rederive.audience_reason: Read by deployed rinzler and runtron in grant mode. It decides which cards, cores and memory nodes the process may use. The Dice daemon sets it.
rederive.default: Not read unless DICE_DAEMON_CHILD is exactly 1. The two C++ functions that read it (dice_grant_env_complete and the functions below) are reached only in grant mode. In grant mode an unset value fails startup with 'Incomplete Dice grant environment; launch through Dice again' (src/system/system.cpp:1667).
rederive.effect: Names the slots that the Dice daemon granted to this process. A slot is one equal share of the server (FPGA cards, CPU cores, memory). The C++ code works out the one --instance that the slots form: instance id = first slot / run length, instance count = total slots / run length (src/system/system.cpp:1697-1698). It takes the permitted cards, CPU cores and NUMA nodes for these slots from the trusted resource map, or from the built-in table when no map matches (src/system/system.cpp:1699-1708).
rederive.empty_value: Same as unset. In grant mode startup fails with the 'Incomplete Dice grant environment' message.
rederive.how_to_check: On success the instance worked out from the slots shows in 'Configured instance <id>,<count> using resource map (<path>).' (src/system/system.cpp:1986) or 'Configured instance <id>,<count> using hardcoded settings.' (src/system/system.cpp:1989). These lines also appear without Dice. The slot list itself is printed only in the error lines listed under invalid_value.
rederive.interactions: Read only in grant mode (DICE_DAEMON_CHILD=1). The --instance in SYSTEM_CONFIG must describe the same slots. If not, startup fails with 'Dice grant <id>: --instance requested '<x,y>'; permitted --instance <a>,<b> (slots [...])' (src/system/system.cpp:1789-1795) or 'SYSTEM_CONFIG --instance does not match DICE_SLOTS' (src/system/system.cpp:1512). The Python tools parse the same variable with looser rules. bin/slice accepts ranges such as 0-7 and spaces (parse_slot_mask, bin/slice:1115-1138). bin/rinzler accepts spaces and empty items (bin/rinzler:507-516). The C++ parser rejects those forms. The Dice daemon writes the canonical form: slot numbers joined with commas (bin/dice:3656).
rederive.invalid_value: Text that does not parse: 'Dice grant <id>: DICE_SLOTS requested 'invalid'; permitted slot IDs. ...' (src/system/system.cpp:1672) or 'Invalid DICE_SLOTS for Dice grant' (src/system/system.cpp:1504). Slots that do not form one supported instance: 'DICE_SLOTS requested '[...]'; permitted one supported contiguous instance within 0-<last slot>' (src/system/system.cpp:1695-1696), or 'permitted trusted map shapes' (src/system/system.cpp:1703-1704), or 'permitted supported fallback shapes' (src/system/system.cpp:1706-1707). Startup fails in each case.
